text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains around 1.2–1.3% over 24 hours, suggesting a steady recovery mood rather than euphoria. The Fear & Greed index sits at 69 (Greed) and has climbed 3 points in a week, indicating growing confidence, though Bitcoin dominance at 59.5% shows altcoins are holding their own and not being aggressively sold off. Volume of $40B is moderate, signaling there's conviction behind the move up but not the kind of manic activity that typically precedes sharp reversals.
